query_conversational_vlm: query the HuggingFace HF Inference API with a multimodal message containing text and an image URL
send_vision_inference_request: send a vision-language model request to describe an image using the Llama 3.2 11B model
extract_chat_response: extract the assistant message from the HF Inference API response choices array
configure_hf_auth_headers: configure Bearer token authorization headers from the HF_TOKEN environment variable
post_multimodal_payload: post a multimodal chat payload with text and image_url content types to the v1/chat/completions endpoint
